latest_release.name: bla-agents: v3.2.0
latest_release.body:
## bla-agents 3.2.0

Minor release extending opt-in `sidecarEntangle` to **Bun / EOF-preserved native companions** and closing the defenseScore honesty gap when entanglement is left OFF.

### Added
- **Sidecar Bun companion strip⇒fail (`.bla-sidecar.v1.json`):** `generateSidecarBunCompanionNote` / `bindBunSidecarEntanglement` / `entangleBunEntryWithSidecars` / `verifyBunSidecarCompanionNote`. When `sidecarEntangle` is on, `protectTarget` auto-binds the planted `<binary>.bunfs-snapshot` via a sibling companion note without rewriting the Bun/EOF-preserved binary (runtime red line). `hardenProject` Bun-only post-pass covers native trees with no JS/Python/WASM entry. Default still OFF (`--sidecar-entangle` / MCP `sidecar_entangle` / `.blarc sidecarEntangle`).
- **defenseScore honesty gap `sidecar-entangle-not-enabled`:** soft-cap 93 when formats that support sidecarEntangle (JS/TS/HTML/ASAR/WASM/Python/native) were verified without the opt-in. Plumbed as `sidecarEntangleEnabled` / MCP `sidecar_entangle_enabled` (mirrors self-seal honesty).

### Fixed
- **`hardenProject` sidecar post-pass TypeScript:** replaced invalid `options.inPlace` references (introduced by #148) with `allowLinkWriteThrough: false` so `tsc` passes; harden always writes under the output directory.

### Gates
- `npm test`: 640 passed / 4 skipped
- `node dist/cli.js benchmark`: 14/14

npm: `npm i bla-agents@3.2.0`
